ukberi-tibyan:1-2.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (الم (١) تَنْزِيلُ الْكِتَابِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ (٢))
His saying (الم): it may be a mubtadaʾ (subject), with «تَنْزِيلُ» its khabar (predicate).
التَّنْزِيلُ ("the sending down") has the meaning of الْمُنَزَّلُ ("what is sent down"), and in meaning it is as we mentioned at the beginning of [Sūrat] al-Baqara. On this view (لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الْكِتَابِ, and what governs it is تَنْزِيلُ.
And (مِنْ رَبِّ) is also attached (mutaʿalliq) to تَنْزِيلُ. It may also be a ḥāl of the pronoun in (فِيهِ), with the adverbial phrase (al-ẓarf) governing it; لَا رَيْبَ here is indeclinable (mabnī).
It is also permissible for (تَنْزِيلُ) to be a mubtadaʾ and «لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ» the khabar, with (مِنْ رَبِّ) a ḥāl as above. On this view (مِنْ) may not be attached to تَنْزِيلُ, because the maṣdar (verbal noun) has already been given a predicate.
It is also permissible for the khabar to be «مِنْ رَبِّ», with «وَلَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ» a ḥāl of الْكِتَابِ; and for it to be a second khabar after a first.

ukberi-tibyan:3-3.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَمْ يَقُولُونَ افْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَا أَتَاهُمْ مِنْ نَذِيرٍ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ (٣))
His saying (أَمْ يَقُولُونَ): «أَمْ» here is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, i.e. "rather, do they say?" (بَلْ أَيَقُولُونَ).
And «مَا» in «مَا أَتَاهُمْ» is negative, and the statement is a naʿt (adjective) of قَوْمًا.

ukberi-tibyan:5-5.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (يُدَبِّرُ الْأَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ (٥))
His saying (مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ): it may be a naʿt (adjective) of أَلْفَ, and it may be a naʿt of سَنَةٍ.

ukberi-tibyan:6-7.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (ذَلِكَ عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ (٦) الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهُ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْإِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِينٍ (٧))
His saying (الَّذِي أَحْسَنَ): it may be the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "He is the one who" (هُوَ الَّذِي), or a second khabar after a first.
[Or] (الْعَزِيزُ) is a mubtadaʾ, «الرَّحِيمُ» a naʿt (adjective), and «الَّذِي» its khabar.
And (خَلْقَهُ) with sukūn on the lām is a badal (substitute) of «كُلَّ», a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl), i.e. "He made excellent the creation of everything".
It may also be a first object (mafʿūl bihi), with «كُلَّ شَيْءٍ» the second, أَحْسَنَ having the meaning of "made known" (عَرَّفَ), i.e. "He made His servants know everything".
It is also read with fatḥa on the lām (خَلَقَهُ), as a past verb; it is then a naʿt of كُلَّ or of شَيْءٍ.

ukberi-tibyan:10-10.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَقَالُوا أَئِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْأَرْضِ أَئِنَّا لَفِي خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَاءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَافِرُونَ (١٠))
His saying (أَئِذَا ضَلَلْنَا): with ḍād, i.e. "we have gone and perished"; and with ṣād (صَلَلْنَا), i.e. "we have become putrid", from your saying صَلَّ اللَّحْمُ, when meat becomes putrid.
What governs «إِذَا» is the meaning of the clause that begins with «إِنَّا», i.e. "when we have perished, shall we be raised?" (إِذَا هَلَكْنَا نُبْعَثُ). «جَدِيدٍ» does not govern it, because what comes after «إِنَّ» does not govern what precedes it.

ukberi-tibyan:12-12.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَلَوْ تَرَى إِذِ الْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُو رُءُوسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَا أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ (١٢))
(وَلَوْ تَرَى): it is from seeing with the eye, and the object (mafʿūl bihi) is omitted, i.e. "if you could see the criminals"; the mubtadaʾ (subject) [الْمُجْرِمُونَ] made mentioning it unnecessary. «إِذْ» here refers to the future; we have mentioned the like of this in [Sūrat] al-Baqara. The implied form is "saying: our Lord" (يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا); the position of the omitted element is that of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and what governs it is «نَاكِسُوا».

ukberi-tibyan:14-14.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَذُوقُوا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَاءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا إِنَّا نَسِينَاكُمْ وَذُوقُوا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ (١٤))
His saying (فَذُوقُوا بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ): i.e. "so taste the punishment". It is also permissible for the object (mafʿūl bihi) of «فَذُوقُوا» to be «لِقَاءَ», according to the view of the Kufans in letting the first [of two competing verbs] govern; and it is permissible for the object of «ذُوقُوا» to be «هَذَا», i.e. "this punishment".

ukberi-tibyan:16-16.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ (١٦))
His saying (تَتَجَافَى) and (يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ): they are in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial).
And (خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا) has been mentioned in [Sūrat] al-Aʿrāf.

ukberi-tibyan:17-17.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ (١٧))
His saying (مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ): «مَا» may be an interrogative, its position being the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), with «أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ» its khabar (predicate), according to the reading of those who put fatḥa on the yāʾ. According to the reading of those who put sukūn on it (أُخْفِي) and make it the imperfect "I hide", «مَا» is in the position of the accusative, governed by أُخْفِي.
It is also permissible for «مَا» to have the meaning of الَّذِي ("that which"), in the accusative, governed by تَعْلَمُ.
And (مِنْ قُرَّةِ), on both views, is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «أُخْفِيَ».
And (جَزَاءً) is a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "they were recompensed with a recompense" (جُوزُوا جَزَاءً).

ukberi-tibyan:18-18.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًا لَا يَسْتَوُونَ (١٨))
His saying (لَا يَسْتَوُونَ): it is resumptive (mustaʾnaf) and has no grammatical position, and it has the meaning of the implied sense mentioned above. And (نُزُلًا) has been mentioned in [Sūrat] Āl ʿImrān.

ukberi-tibyan:20-20.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا فَمَأْوَاهُمُ النَّارُ كُلَّمَا أَرَادُوا أَنْ يَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا أُعِيدُوا فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ (٢٠))
His saying (الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ): it is a naʿt (adjective) of الْعَذَابِ, in the position of the accusative.
It may also be a naʿt of النَّارِ, put in the masculine on the sense of الْجَحِيم ("Hellfire") or الْحَرِيق ("the burning").

ukberi-tibyan:23-23.t:
Allah the Exalted said: {وَلَقَد آتَيْنَا مُوسَى الْكتاب فَلَا تكن فِي مرية من لِقَائِه وجعلناه هدى لبني إِسْرَائِيل}
His saying (مِنْ لِقَائِهِ): the hāʾ may be the pronoun of the name of Allah, i.e. "of Moses' meeting Allah", so the maṣdar (verbal noun) is in genitive construct with its object; and it may be the pronoun of Moses, so that it is in genitive construct with its agent.
It is also said: it refers back to the Book, as Allah the Exalted said: (وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْآنَ).
It is also said: [it means] "of your meeting, O Muḥammad, Moses" — may Allah bless them both and grant them peace — on the night of the Ascension (al-Miʿrāj).

ukberi-tibyan:24-24.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا وَكَانُوا بِآيَاتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ (٢٤))
(لَمَّا) with shadda is an adverb (ẓarf), and what governs it is «جَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ» or يَهْدُونَ. And with the lightened form and kasra on the lām (لِمَا), on the basis that it [مَا] is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya).

ukberi-tibyan:26-26.t:
Allah the Exalted said: (أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِي مَسَاكِنِهِمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَآيَاتٍ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ (٢٦))
(كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا): this has been mentioned in [Sūrat] Ṭā Hā.
